title: galium mollugo subsp. tyrolense
intro: Galium mollugo subsp. tyrolense, commonly known as the Tyrolean bedstraw, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bedstraw family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Galium mollugo subsp. tyrolense include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
